edition: Steam Black Gate with Forge of Virtue, native Windows development build
authority: Original Use, RunUsable, container handling and retail Usecode. No item-specific replacement scripts or quest flag overrides.
shared_fixes: Remove the town USE shape allowlist, including the locked-chest shortcut; original code decides the outcome.
Expose original map, sign and remote-view displays through one ClassicUO modal adapter instead of waiting for hidden native-window input.
Forward item barks as well as NPC barks, and original ReportNoCanDo feedback.
Start the full resource-cache discard scan at its first slot; previously more than 37 cached resources could raise E401 despite released blocks.
Bound asynchronous client observations to five seconds and record the last interaction and native hold flags on failure.
Explain pending targets and displays on attempted movement; restore a missing modal while its original prompt remains active.

inventory.checks: Avatar and Iolo equipment/backpack contents; complete or cancel original prompts, verify movement, reload isolated save after each item. Verify AUDITVISIT is unavailable without the audit environment.

town.selection: One original instance per shape with LINKDEP1 Usecode or container metadata, drawn from reviewed Trinsic world, fixed and contained references.
town.checks: Original dispatch, prompt completion/cancellation, zero active Usecode and movement holds, then movement on a clear road. Feedback and refusals are retained.
town.positioning: AUDITVISIT uses TeleportParty only with TRINSIC_PREPARE=interaction-audit and bounded Trinsic coordinates. Production launchers do not enable it.

client.checks: Original cloth map via close button and Escape, original sign via Escape, rendered screenshots, resumed movement.

companion_and_key_regression.checks: Cancel and feed, use within open backpack, party transfers, occupied equipment slot, equip/unequip, save/restart, companion dialogue plus paperdoll, original murder-scene key unlocks Christopher's chest.

timeout_reproduction.method: Candidate client paired with pre-fix native host in an isolated save; USE 104 reproduces hidden map input wait.
timeout_reproduction.result: Client reports bounded interaction timeout with USE 104 recorded, rather than an indefinitely pending observation.

limits: Town matrix tests dispatch and return of control, not every frame, target combination or quest outcome. Some original interactions legitimately refuse the action.
Target prompts are cancelled in the broad matrix. Feeding and the murder-scene key have separate effect assertions.
Town observer teleport qualifies interaction/control return, not pathfinding or physical access to every object.
The shared remote-view adapter is implemented but no accessible Trinsic remote-view item was exercised in the matrix.
Timeout diagnostics do not forcibly clear original game flags or rewind a running script.
Existing saves and the frozen Trinsic playtest build are not modified.
